# inbox-dedup

> Inbox pattern for idempotent message consumers: record message ids in the handler's transaction so redelivered messages are skipped, in SQLite or memory Python package `trysac-inbox-dedup`, import name `inbox_dedup`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
